messages.body:
The workload autoscaler on our GKE cluster keeps recommending different CPU and memory
requests for several deployments, but the pod requests never actually change. The
recommendations are visible in the console and look sensible.

Are we missing a switch so the workload autoscaler applies the recommendations?
Which components should we check first?

grounding: A correct support reply addresses the workload-autoscaler apply behavior (recommendations vs. automated apply) grounded in documentation/source evidence.
